title: newa-mid-atlantic-heavyweight
label: Lycos

won.source: The fed's own dated show results, 17 January 1999 (read for this accession, not served).

how: Pinned Mac Michaels with a foreign object (a "slap jack").
note: Still billed as reigning "Mid-Atlantic Champion" in the fed's own News page, 27 January 1999 (promotions/newa-mid-atlantic/archive/news.html), submitted for a unification match against "EWC" Television Champion HICAL at the NeWA PPV Lord of the Rings. No document records how or when this reign ended; the fed's own Title History page omits Lycos and this reign entirely.

title: newa-mid-atlantic-tag-team
label: Angels of the Night

won.source: The fed's own Title History page (promotions/newa-mid-atlantic/archive/title-history.html).

note: The only reign this holding attests. Held by the same-named Angels of the Night already carrying the BCW National Tag Team Championship on the NeWA hub's own sister territory in Great Britain — read as the same touring team, presumed rather than proven, given the hub's own explicit cross-territory roster movement (see this wing's own Affiliations). The fed's own News page (27 January 1999) implies an earlier, unattested reign predating even this one, asking rhetorically whether the champions have defended "even once since Crowing Event" [sic] — no date, match, or result survives for that named event.

won.source: The fed's own dated show results, 16 January 1999 (read for this accession, not served).

end.source: The fed's own News page, 27 January 1999 (promotions/newa-mid-atlantic/archive/news.html).

note: Retained against John Cole, 17 January 1999. Stripped by Jim Crockett, Jr. on 27 January 1999, citing his and JD Johnson's own conduct, and ordered into a best-of-seven series against Johnson to decide the vacant title — no result for that series survives anywhere held. Fred Rogers is next attested champion on 10 February 1999, via a Three Way Elimination Match rather than any resolution of the ordered series.
